publicationDecision.authorisation: Standing Medicines Watch instruction: supported factual additions and corrections may go live without repeat permission.
publicationDecision.scope: Publish four primary-source-reviewed international registry omissions through the guarded workflow; this is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

entries.name: DA-302168S tablets
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a recruiting Chinese Phase 3 placebo-controlled study of once-daily oral DA-302168S, described there as a small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist, in adults with overweight or obesity. Actual study start was 19 June 2026; estimated enrolment is 840.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Recruitment, estimated October 2027 completion and planned outcomes are not completed results. No results are posted, and the record does not establish efficacy, superiority, authorisation or supply.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07629544
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record and API response read for recruiting Phase 3 status, oral formulation, mechanism description, actual start, estimated enrolment and completion, Chinese location and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: NNC0662-0419 injection
entries.stage: Completed Phase 1 registry; no results posted
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records a completed first-in-human Phase 1 study of once-weekly subcutaneous NNC0662-0419 in 100 participants with overweight or obesity. It used single- and multiple-ascending-dose cohorts and completed on 26 July 2025.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Completed registry status does not mean results have been published or establish efficacy. No results are posted, and the registry does not state a mechanism or establish a later development stage, authorisation, access or supply.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06737536
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record and API response read for completed Phase 1 status, once-weekly subcutaneous formulation, actual dates, 100-participant enrolment and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: DR10624 injection
entries.stage: Completed Phase 1 registry; no results posted
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry describes DR10624 as a subcutaneous Fc-fusion tri-agonist targeting GLP-1, glucagon and FGF21 receptors. Its 153-participant first-in-human Phase 1 study completed on 31 January 2025.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Completed registry status does not establish efficacy or continued development. No results are posted, and the record does not establish a later trial, authorisation, access or supply.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05378893
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record and API response read for completed Phase 1 status, stated tri-agonist mechanism, subcutaneous formulation, actual dates, 153-participant enrolment and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: CMS-D008 injection
entries.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry describes a Chinese first-in-human Phase 1 study of subcutaneous CMS-D008 with single-dose, multiple-dose and expansion cohorts in healthy adults and adults with overweight or obesity.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for this programme or formulation.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development or a registry listing does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The record remained not yet recruiting at its 8 April 2026 update, with no listed location, although its estimated start was 2 April 2026. Estimated dates and a registered design are not first dosing, results, authorisation, access or supply; the reviewed record does not state a mechanism.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07518589
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record and API response read for not-yet-recruiting Phase 1 status, subcutaneous formulation, planned cohorts, estimated dates, missing locations and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

discoveryLimitations.configuredSourcePass: The live SELECT-only endpoint remained available and current for all 50 configured sources after the earlier four-route repair; a successful retrieval does not renew unrelated medical reviews.
discoveryLimitations.currentDatePass: No new UK MHRA, NICE or NHS authorisation or access decision was found for these four programmes. The same-day SYNCHRONIZE-2 result was already present in the live catalogue and was not duplicated.
discoveryLimitations.broaderUndatedPass: The undated registry and mechanism pass found these four older omissions among smaller and international developers. Registry publication lag means this remains a selected, non-exhaustive catalogue.
discoveryLimitations.plannedVersusCompleted: DA-302168S is recruiting; NNC0662-0419 and DR10624 are registry-completed without posted results; CMS-D008 remains not yet recruiting. None is described as a completed successful treatment programme.
discoveryLimitations.monitoring: No automatic monitoring source, successful baseline, review renewal or all-green claim is created by this publication.
